description: Vehicle 1 approaches an intersection and turns right. After Vehicle 1 completes the right turn onto its exit road, a pedestrian crosses diagonally across Vehicle 1’s lane: the pedestrian starts from the right edge of the road and moves toward the left edge while also moving forward along the exit road direction. Vehicle 2 approaches from the perpendicular road to the right of Vehicle 1’s original approach and goes straight through the intersection. Vehicle 3 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 on Vehicle 1’s exit road and starts behind Vehicle 1 in the adjacent lane.
